description.zh:
备份集ID，可通过查询备份列表接口DescribeBackups获取。

指定此参数时，**DBInstanceId**参数为可选。

>**BackupId**和**RestoreTime**两者至少传入一个。
description.en:
The backup set ID. You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the backup set ID.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **DBInstanceId**.

>  You must specify at least one of the **BackupId** or **RestoreTime** parameters.

description.zh: 新实例规格。详情请参见[实例规格](~~26312~~)。
description.en: The instance type of the new instance. For more information, see [Instance types](~~26312~~).

description.zh:
原实例ID。

> * 按备份集恢复（即指定BackupId参数）时，本参数不是必须项。
> * 按时间点恢复（即指定RestoreTime参数）时，本参数为必须项。
description.en:
The ID of the original instance.

> *   If you specify BackupId, you do not need to specify this parameter.
> *   If you specify RestoreTime, you must also specify this parameter.

description.zh:
新实例存储容量。单位：GB。详情请参见[实例规格](~~26312~~)。

> 新实例的磁盘空间不能小于原实例的磁盘空间。
description.en:
The storage capacity of the new instance. Unit: GB. For more information, see [Instance types](~~26312~~).

>  You must set this parameter to a value that is greater than or equal to the storage capacity of the original instance.

description.zh:
新实例存储类型，取值：
* **local\_ssd/ephemeral\_ssd**：本地SSD盘
* **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘
* **cloud_essd**：ESSD云盘
description.en:
The storage type of the new instance. Valid values:

*   **local_ssd/ephemeral_ssd**: local SSD
*   **cloud_ssd**: standard SSD.
*   **cloud_essd**: enhanced SSD (ESSD)

description.zh:
数据库名称，恢复数据至新实例时格式为：`原库名1,新库名2`。

> 如需恢复到已有实例，请参见[CopyDatabaseBetweenInstances](~~2628854~~)。
description.en:
The name of the database. When you restore data to a new instance, the format of the database name is `Original database name 1,New database name 2`.

>  For more information about how to restore data to an existing instance, see [CopyDatabaseBetweenInstances](~~2628854~~).

description.zh:
新实例网络类型：
* **Classic**：经典网络
* **VPC**：专有网络

默认与原实例网络类型一致。
description.en:
The network type of the new instance. Valid values:

*   **Classic**
*   **VPC**

By default, the new instance uses the same network type as the original instance.

description.zh:
新实例付费类型：
* **Postpaid**：后付费（按量付费）
* **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
description.en:
The billing method of the new instance. Valid values:

*   **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
*   **Prepaid**: subscription.

description.zh:
指定新的预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
* **Year**：包年
* **Month**：包月

> 若参数**PayType**=**Prepaid**，该参数必须传入。
description.en:
The unit that is used to calculate the billing cycle of the new instance. This parameter takes effect only when you select the subscription billing method for the new instance. Valid values:

*   **Year**
*   **Month**

> This parameter must be specified when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

description.zh: 设置新实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过**VPCId**和**VSwitchId**自动分配。
description.en: The internal IP address of the new instance. The internal IP address must be within the CIDR block that is supported by the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns an internal IP address based on the values of the **VPCId** and **VSwitchId** parameters.

description.zh: 备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 指定此参数时，**DBInstanceId**参数为必须。 >**BackupId**和**RestoreTime**两者至少传入一个。
description.en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. The point in time must fall within the specified log backup retention period. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DBInstanceId**.

> You must specify at least one of **BackupId** and **RestoreTime**.
The ID of the destination instance.

description.zh:
指定新实例购买时长，取值：
* 当参数**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1~3**。
* 当参数**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1~9**。

> 若付费类型为**Prepaid**则该参数必须传入。
description.en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

*   Valid values when **Period** is set to **Year**: **1 to 3**.****
*   Valid values when **Period** is set to **Month**: **1 to 9**.****

> This parameter must be specified when PayType is set to **Prepaid**.
The VPC ID of the new instance.

description.zh: 新实例虚拟交换机ID，多个值用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The vSwitch ID of the new instance. If you specify more than one vSwitch ID, you must separate the IDs with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
### 适用引擎
RDS SQL Server（2012及以上版本的实例） 

### 相关功能文档
><notice>使用该接口前，请仔细阅读功能文档，确保完全了解使用接口的前提条件及使用后造成的影响后，再进行操作。></notice>
[恢复SQL Server数据](~~95722~~)
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engines

SQL Server 2012 or later

### [](#)References

> Before you call this operation, carefully read the following documentation. Make sure that you fully understand the prerequisites and impacts for calling this operation.

[Restore the data of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance](~~95722~~)

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds recovery-db-instance --db-instance-class mssql.x4.medium.s1 --db-instance-storage 40 --pay-type Postpaid --instance-network-type VPC --db-instance-id rm-bp180000 --target-db-instance-id rm-bp170000 --db-names test1,test2 --backup-id 293040000 --restore-time 2011-06-11T16:00:00Z --vpc-id vpc-0000 --vswitch-id vsw-0000 --private-ip-address 172.XX.XX.69 --used-time 1 --period Month --db-instance-storage-type cloud_essd --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds RecoveryDBInstance --region cn-hangzhou --PrivateIpAddress '172.XX.XX.69' --DBInstanceClass 'mssql.x4.medium.s1' --VPCId 'vpc-0000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-0000' --BackupId 293040000 --Period Month --PayType Postpaid --TargetDBInstanceId 'rm-bp170000' --DBInstanceStorageType cloud_essd --InstanceNetworkType VPC --RestoreTime '2011-06-11T16:00:00Z' --DbNames 'test1,test2' --DBInstanceId 'rm-bp180000' --DBInstanceStorage 40 --UsedTime 1
